description: An EVM address's native coin (ETH or POL), USDC and USDT balances on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, read from public RPCs, each with its USD value and a total. USDC is Circle's native contract on each chain; USDT is Tether's (USDT0 on Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon) plus the bridged USDT on Base and Optimism, labelled. Other tokens aren't counted. Fails (and is not charged) if no chain's RPC answers. Costs $0.001 USDC per call.
name: evm_wallet_balance
title: EVM wallet balance
